description: This file configures security settings for the customer-service module of a Spring Boot application. It sets up OAuth2 resource server support with JWT validation, disables CSRF protection, and configures request authorization rules.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up Spring Security for the customer-service, enabling JWT OAuth2 resource server, request authorization, and other security parameters.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain bean that configures HTTP security, OAuth2 JWT processing, and request authorization rules.
